title: Brooklyn MapPLUTO parcel query and pagination replay
coverage: Brooklyn waterfront and Sunset Park test envelope in longitude and latitude, EPSG:4326. The query uses polygon intersection and retains positive lot numbers in the Brooklyn borough.
interpretation: Counts describe features in the cited MapPLUTO edition. OBJECTID is the feature key used to reconcile the query; BBL is the tax-lot identifier. Treat neither as a count of eligible sites or ownership interests. Raw response checksums identify the captured responses. Live source responses can change on a new edition.
